items.text: Claude Code v2.1.323 的[版本说明](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.323)新增了实验性 Code Mode：由 Claude 编写 JavaScript 调用工具，需要主动开启。说明给出了开启，以及为组织关闭这项功能的[文档入口](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/code-mode)。功能仍是实验性可选项，尚未做实测验证。

items.text: Antigravity v2.33.0 的[版本说明](https://antigravity.google/releases?tab=hub&version=2.33.0)新增 SSH 主机连接，可把项目和代理放到远程 64 位 Linux 上运行。入口有三个：侧栏、项目菜单的 SSH Host...、命令面板的 Connect to SSH Host...。连接使用 OpenSSH 和 ~/.ssh/config，远程服务器会自动安装。按官方说明，关闭窗口后，项目、Git worktrees、代理和终端仍会留在主机运行；这点尚未做实际连接验证。

sourceCitations: This release adds SSH host connections for running projects and agents on remote Linux machines
You can now connect the Antigravity App to a remote 64-bit Linux machine over SSH from the sidebar, the project menu (SSH Host...), or the command palette (Connect to SSH Host...).

Antigravity installs its remote server automatically over OpenSSH using your ~/.ssh/config so projects, Git worktrees, agents, and terminals run on the host and keep working even after you close the window.
conditions: This is a version changelog entry, not a standalone major product-update announcement; it must not be dressed up as a major launch.
SSH host connection is described for a remote 64-bit Linux machine, over OpenSSH, using ~/.ssh/config; Antigravity installs its remote server automatically.
/swarm and UI plugin panels are opened to business and enterprise accounts when allowed by organization admin settings.
